name: Inferno (fire)
body:
School evocation [fire]; Level druid 8, sorcerer/wizard 8

EFFECT

Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw Reflex half; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

This effect word deals 1d8 points of fire damage per caster level (maximum 20d8).
